subtitle: Two chapters that differ only in one fenced block
description: A fixture for check-book.sh. Both chapters are structurally valid. The second carries a fenced python block whose body holds a line opening with a hash and a line opening with three hashes, which is the shape a lab stub prints.
Before the fence-awareness fix, chapter 2 fails the H1 test and the H3 test and chapter 1 passes. After it, both pass.
